title: game: I develop my own programming language and to test the limits and perf, I made a small game with it
author: pu1da
selftext: I develop my own programming language (r/tapelang). I wanted to create a video series to Youtube how to build a game with it. To do that, I designed and implemented with Claude Code a youtube oriented 'coding deck' using Tape. Then I made a game, inspired by 'Sir, we have an orcs problem'. Few concept arts with Gemini; and after that Opus 5.5 made a game from it in Tape. Now that was difficult because Opus 5.5 is very good model, but has zero knowledge of my programming language. Along the way it found very many compiler bugs and improved syntax and language expressibility. Once the game was completed, I took the git commits; and split it into Youtube episodes, and then replayed the coding part realtime. I recorded and added voice over and edits to it - to show how the game was built. Game is moddable so you can tinker with it, even if you don't have the source code. It is also fun to play and few hours pass easily.
